title: EvalResult
description: One replay cell: a task re-run at (model tier x skill on/off), carrying objective-track results, judged-track results, or both. Judge outputs always carry the calibration statistic they were validated against and whether they cleared the agreement gate — a judged score without its calibration context is not a legal record. Repetition-level results are kept raw; aggregates always carry n and a CI. 0.2.0 (first real replay run, 2026-08-09): cost gains cache token buckets — ADR-0005 established that cache traffic dominates real agent usage, so input/output alone materially misprices a run — plus cli_reported_cost_usd as a cross-check against the harness's own price-sheet computation.

task_ref.description: The task being replayed, pinned to the classification it was sampled under.

model_tier.description: Org-level tier label (e.g. frontier/mid/small); mapping model_id->tier is versioned in docs/decisions.

replay_config.description: Everything needed to reproduce the cell.

n_runs.description: Repetitions of this cell. n=1 results are reportable but must surface as n=1 downstream — no CI can be computed.

tracks.description: At least one of objective / judged must be present. Both may be — where both exist and disagree, downstream consumers report the disagreement (see routing_policy.triangulation); nothing here averages them.

objective.description: Per-gate results. Each gate is pass/fail/not_applicable — not_applicable is not failure (e.g. no type checker in the repo).

completed.description: False = the agent run itself crashed/timed out; gates above are then null/not_applicable, and this still counts in n.

calibration.description: The judge's validation context — required on every judged record, not looked up elsewhere, so a score can never circulate detached from its calibration.

calibration_n.description: Size of the human-labeled calibration set this judge version was validated on.

cleared_agreement_gate.description: False means these scores are exploratory only and must render as such downstream — they are stored, not hidden, but never feed a routing recommendation.

comparisons.description: Pairwise, position-swapped comparisons — the raw unit of judged evidence.

position_swapped.description: Whether the swapped-order pass was actually run.

position_consistent.description: Did both orderings agree? verdict must be 'inconsistent' when false — positional disagreement is reported, never resolved by picking one.

tokens_input.description: Non-cached input tokens (same bucket semantics as session schema tokens.input).

tokens_cache_read.description: Added 0.2.0 — cache reads dominate agent traffic (ADR-0005); pricing without them is wrong by orders of magnitude.

cost_usd_estimate.description: Computed from the versioned price sheet over ALL four token buckets.

cli_reported_cost_usd.description: Cost as reported by the agent harness itself (e.g. claude -p total_cost_usd), kept as a cross-check; divergence from cost_usd_estimate is a price-sheet bug signal.

aggregate.description: Any summarized metric: value + n always; CI whenever n supports one.
